People: William Shakespeare (other, Wikidata Q692), died 1616. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Shakespeare, William, 1564-1616 [Dubious author]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Complete works. Rev. from the original editions. With historical introductions and notes explanatory and critical, a life of the poet, and an introductory essay on his phraseology & metre, London J. Tallis, 1850, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/pt2completeworks04shak. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 68%, 52%, 76% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
